geopolitics_summary: EU Russia sanctions package clinched after Greek concession on gas shipping; Middle East escalation drives LNG pricing; France domestic political uncertainty over green transition.

themes.headline: Greek concession unlocks EU Russia sanctions, freezes crude price cap
themes.why_it_matters: Resolution of gas shipment dispute clears path for EU sanctions alignment. Direct impact on Russian LNG/pipeline flows to third countries and EU energy supply diversification strategy.

themes.headline: Middle East violence flares; traders pricing in Strait of Hormuz instability
themes.why_it_matters: LNG supply risk via Hormuz disruption. Asian demand surge + regional instability pressures global LNG spot pricing, raising EU TTF arbitrage and winter fill-cycle costs.

themes.headline: NATO seals €27B Cold War fuel network overhaul after Turkey agreement
themes.why_it_matters: Multi-decade military fuel logistics upgrade affects strategic oil/gas infrastructure resilience across NATO members. Indirect bearing on emergency response protocols and fuel security posture.

themes.headline: Moscow-linked nuclear project in northwest Germany receives regulatory green light
themes.why_it_matters: German nuclear capacity addition eases power demand pressure; reduces need for marginal gas-fired generation dispatch. Downward pressure on DA spreads and winter peak pricing.

themes.headline: Global LNG trade volumes hit record 56.3 Bcf/d in 2025; US capacity leading
themes.why_it_matters: Sustained US LNG export growth improves global supply flexibility and supports TTF arbitrage inflows. Higher LNG availability dampens winter spike risk and reduces EU gas price upside.

watchlist: EU Russia sanctions implementation timetable and third-country gas rerouting logistics.
Iran–US escalation trajectory; Strait of Hormuz transit disruption risk to LNG flows.
France green transition policy clarity post-environment ministry realignment (pre-2027 election).
NATO fuel network upgrade phase-in timeline and EU energy infrastructure integration effects.
